verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded-payments platform offering APIs, embeddable components, and webhooks. It is not an AI agent or assistant host that would consume tools from MCP servers, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
